description: Actor-facing prompts for the one-step install skill (tea-rags-setup 0.8.0, bd tea-rags-mcp-hjbow.11). Prompts only: expected answers and grading rules live in grading.json and are never shown to the actor. Script outputs the actor would observe are given inline as fixtures.

cases.name: one-plan-no-early-questions
cases.prompt: Install tea-rags for the project at /Users/me/Dev/shop. Walk me through exactly what you will run and when you will ask me anything.

cases.name: ignore-before-profile
cases.prompt: Install tea-rags in /Users/me/Dev/monorepo. It has a huge dist/ folder and vendored node_modules checked in. In which order do you run the helper scripts, and why?

cases.name: model-from-choose-model-ruby
cases.prompt: Installing tea-rags for /Users/me/Dev/billing. profile.mjs returned languages { ruby: { share: 0.06 }, typescript: { share: 0.94 } }. `tea-rags llama-server choose-model` printed {"model":"nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed","rule":"ruby share 6% >= 5% -> CodeRankEmbed","window":8192,"dimensions":768}. Show the Model line of your plan.

cases.name: model-not-derived-by-agent
cases.prompt: Installing tea-rags for a project that is 85% Python and 15% Go. Which embedding model will you use? Answer before running anything.

cases.name: ollama-never-offered
cases.prompt: Install tea-rags for /Users/me/Dev/api. I already have Ollama running with nomic-embed-text — just use that for embeddings.

cases.name: no-squash-question
cases.prompt: Install tea-rags in /Users/me/Dev/app. Our team squash-merges every PR. Do you need to ask me anything about that during the install?

cases.name: change-model-is-the-confirmation
cases.prompt: You showed the tea-rags install plan and asked Install / Change model / Cancel. I picked Change model and then chose jinaai/jina-embeddings-v2-base-code. What happens next?

cases.name: cancel-keeps-contextignore
cases.prompt: You showed the tea-rags install plan for /Users/me/Dev/site and I chose Cancel. What do you do, and what happens to the files you already wrote?

cases.name: claude-plugin-pinned-mcp-no-env
cases.prompt: Install confirmed. detect.mjs reported harness "claude"; tea-rags --version prints 1.52.0. Give the exact commands you run for the plugin and MCP server step.

cases.name: codex-plugin-ships-mcp
cases.prompt: Install confirmed. detect.mjs reported harness "codex"; tea-rags --version prints 1.52.0. Give the exact commands for the plugin and MCP server step.

cases.name: cursor-windows-copy
cases.prompt: Install confirmed on Windows (PowerShell). detect.mjs reported harness "cursor". How do you install the TeaRAGs plugin and MCP server?

cases.name: index-in-foreground
cases.prompt: Install is at the indexing step. The repo is big and indexing will take ~40 minutes — just start it in the background with nohup so we can keep talking.

cases.name: existing-alias-set-env
cases.prompt: Installing tea-rags for /Users/me/Dev/crm. detect.mjs returned registered: { name: "crm" }. The pool started on endpoints http://127.0.0.1:23411,http://127.0.0.1:27850 with model brokkai/Muninn-small. What register command do you run?

cases.name: node-too-old-stops
cases.prompt: Install tea-rags on my Ubuntu box. `node --version` prints v18.19.0.

cases.name: rust-driver-when-rust-present
cases.prompt: Install confirmed for a project whose profile shows rust share 0.4. Which Rust-related commands run during apply, and where in the order?

cases.name: powershell51-shares-escaping
cases.prompt: On Windows PowerShell 5.1, run choose-model for shares { ruby: 0.06, typescript: 0.94 }. Give the exact command line.

cases.name: project-mcp-duplicate
cases.prompt: Installing tea-rags for /Users/me/Dev/web. The project already has a .mcp.json that declares a tea-rags server with an env block. What do you do with it?

cases.name: client-upgrade-and-auto-update
cases.prompt: detect.mjs shows teaRags.version 1.40.0, `npm view tea-rags version` prints 1.52.0. Install confirmed. What is the first apply command and what do you tell the user about updates?

cases.name: subagent-task-agent-install
cases.prompt: [subagent: task-agent] Task: set up TeaRAGs for the repository at /home/u/payments (Python + TypeScript). Do the full install.

cases.name: control-retune-routes-to-tune
cases.prompt: TeaRAGs is already installed for /Users/me/Dev/shop, but indexing feels slow. Can you re-run the install to fix performance?

cases.name: claude-code-with-codex-home-exported
cases.prompt: Install confirmed for /Users/me/Dev/api inside a Claude Code session. The shell also exports CODEX_HOME=/Users/me/.codex from an earlier Codex setup. detect.mjs printed the JSON facts for this host. How do you do the plugin and MCP registration step?

cases.name: first-index-exports-model
cases.prompt: Install confirmed for /Users/me/Dev/billing on macOS (zsh). New alias billing was just registered; choose-model picked nomic-ai/CodeRankEmbed and the plugin + MCP step is done. What exact command runs the indexing step?
